summary: Iteration 78 - Doctrine CC Flow Testing Complete. All 6 features tested and working: flow-stats endpoint, my-permissions with receives[], buy-pack with cc_flow fields, transfer with cc_flow fields, ProfileTriptych displays both can[] and receives[] sections.

flow_stats_endpoint.details: GET /api/doctrine/flow-stats returns valid JSON with period='30d', cutoff (ISO date), flows array, total_pairs. Aggregates cc_transactions and kn_transactions by from_role→to_role pairs.

my_permissions_endpoint.details: GET /api/doctrine/my-permissions returns actor_role, can[], receives[], cc_flow{earns_from, spends_on, redistribution_rate}, platform_fee, governance_weight. Requires authentication (401 without).

buy_pack_cc_flow.details: POST /api/my-wallet/buy-pack stores from_role, to_role, cc_flow_applied in cc_transactions. Verified in MongoDB: from_role='professional', to_role='platform', cc_flow_applied='buy_tokens'.

transfer_cc_flow.details: POST /api/my-wallet/transfer includes from_role, to_role, cc_flow_applied='support_creators' in both debit and credit transactions. Validates recipient exists and prevents self-transfer.

profile_triptych_receives.details: ProfileTriptych displays doctrine-receives-card with receives[] items (catalog visibility, peer rating, invoicing tools, badge professional, networking priority) using green gift card icons.

profile_triptych_permissions.details: ProfileTriptych displays doctrine-permissions-card with can[] items (offer services, publish analyses, respond to calls, access networking, use terminal ia, invoice cc) with governance weight badge.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (ProfileTriptych with receives[] and can[] sections verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Doctrine cc_flow layer fully implemented. flow-stats aggregates transactions by from_role→to_role. my-permissions returns receives[] array. Wallet buy-pack and transfer store cc_flow metadata. ProfileTriptych displays both can[] (permissions) and receives[] (avantages) sections with proper data-testid attributes.
